detailed_description:

The target video is a premium live-action psychological science-fiction thriller, grounded and disturbing rather than action-driven. Clinical, near-black cinematography, cold blue practical lighting, subtle film grain, realistic skin, immaculate production design, restrained performances and deliberate visual composition. The atmosphere feels like an expensive, unsettling anthology television episode about identity and technological replacement.

[Shot 1] 0.0–3.5s — THE WAITING ROOM.

A symmetrical wide shot establishes <Subject 1>, the dark minimalist chamber with its enormous centered black doorway outlined in cold blue light. Three people stand several meters in front of the door, seen from behind at a slight three-quarter angle. On the left stands <Subject 2>, the heavyset blond young man in his turquoise polo and tan shorts. In the middle stands <Subject 3>, the blonde woman in her vivid yellow sweater and pink tights. On the right stands <Subject 4>, the older slender man in his purple and turquoise windbreaker.

Their strangely colorful everyday clothing contrasts sharply with the sterile futuristic architecture.

The camera pushes forward slowly with small amplitude. Nobody speaks. The door appears dormant, its black interior reflecting almost no light.

Suddenly, the blue outline emits one gentle pulse.

<Subject 3> takes a cautious step toward it. <Subject 2> glances nervously at <Subject 4>, who remains completely motionless.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500 — THE REFLECTION.

Hard cut to a medium close-up from the side of <Subject 3> standing directly before the black doorway.

Her face is illuminated by the thin blue border. She raises her right hand slowly toward the dark surface.

A realistic reflection of her face gradually appears within the black glass.

But something is wrong.

Her reflection raises its hand BEFORE the real woman does.

The real woman abruptly stops moving.

Her reflection does not stop.

It completes the movement and presses its palm against the inside of the glass.

The original woman stares in disbelief. Her breath catches. The reflected face begins forming a tiny, unnatural smile while her real face remains frightened and completely still.

The camera makes a slow, subtle push toward the two almost identical faces.

A soft electronic click breaks the silence.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000 — THE REPLACEMENT.

Hard cut to a medium-wide three-quarter view of the doorway.

The black surface silently ripples like thick liquid glass.

<Subject 3> instinctively takes two steps backward, keeping her eyes fixed on it.

An identical young blonde woman, <Subject 5>, steps forward out of the dark doorway and into the room.

Her appearance is completely identical to the original: the same blonde waves, butterfly hair clips, yellow sweater, black skirt, neon-pink tights and heavy platform boots.

The two women stand facing each other.

The original woman is visibly terrified.

The duplicate appears perfectly relaxed.

Behind them, <Subject 2> instinctively backs away, his mouth slightly open. <Subject 4> stares at the newcomer without blinking.

The camera remains stable and allows the impossible duplication to register clearly. There is no explosive portal effect, smoke or dramatic transformation. The replacement simply walks out as if this were an ordinary procedure.

[Shot 4] At 00:11.000 — THE BETTER VERSION.

Hard cut to a tight, carefully composed medium shot of the two identical women standing face-to-face. The dark doorway and its cold blue border remain visible behind the duplicate.

<Subject 3> stands frozen, breathing shallowly, her eyes widening as she studies her own face.

<Subject 5> calmly adjusts one butterfly hair clip, using the exact familiar gesture of the original woman.

She looks directly into the original woman's eyes.

With a gentle, reassuring, almost customer-service smile, <Subject 5> (S1), speaking in a soft, natural young female voice with unnerving emotional detachment, says:

<d>[English] They won't know the difference.</d>

A brief silence.

The camera makes a small lateral movement, revealing <Subject 2> and <Subject 4> behind them.

<Subject 2> looks between the two identical women, completely unable to tell which one is real.

<Subject 4> slowly turns his head toward the duplicate.

Instead of looking frightened, he gives her a tiny, knowing smile.

The duplicate returns the exact same smile.

The blue light around the doorway pulses once.

The original woman notices the exchange.

Her expression changes from confusion to pure dread.

At 14.6 seconds, hard cut to absolute black.

Hold black until 15.0 seconds.

No title cards, no explanatory text, no additional characters, no exaggerated horror expressions. The final revelation must feel quiet, plausible and deeply disturbing.

overall_soundscape:

Extremely restrained, realistic sound design. A quiet low-frequency ventilation hum and faint electrical resonance fill the chamber. Soft shoe movements echo over the polished floor. The door emits a delicate electromagnetic pulse at approximately 2.5 seconds. During the reflection anomaly, a tiny glass-like electronic click is heard, followed by almost complete silence. As the duplicate emerges, the black surface produces a subtle viscous displacement sound, accompanied by two precise footsteps on the reflective floor. Natural breathing and clothing movement remain audible. The duplicate's spoken line is intimate, clearly articulated and completely free of robotic voice effects. At the final blue-light pulse, a short deep electrical tone sounds before the cut to black.

non_diegetic_music:

Minimalist premium psychological-thriller scoring. A barely audible deep analog synthesizer drone begins beneath the opening shot. Slowly introduce an irregular, unsettling two-note pattern built from detuned synthetic tones and a very distant low cello texture. No conventional melody, no rhythmic percussion, no orchestral trailer impacts. The score becomes subtly more dissonant as the reflection moves independently. At the moment the duplicate emerges, introduce a brief sub-bass pressure swell, then reduce the music almost to silence. Leave the spoken line completely unobstructed. After the older man's knowing smile, one very low unresolved electronic note appears and is cut instantly at the final black frame.
